d: If you wake up with stiff hips, a tight lower back, or that locked-up feeling that makes you move older than you actually are, this video is for you. In this five minute bodyweight mobility routine, I'm going to show you five exercises you can do anywhere, with no equipment, to start restoring the hip and lower back motion you lose when you sit too much, train too hard, sleep in the wrong positions, or simply ignore your mobility for too long.
